transcript.text: Please build a rerunnable cleaning recipe for the bookings table: drop rows with destination TEST, parse price strings like '1200 AED' into a numeric price_aed column, keep cancelled unchanged, and output one clean table. I'll rerun it every Monday on the new export before training my model. [shares bookings.csv]

Recipe started. Here's what DCLab will do, in that order:

1. 2. **Parse price** — strip the currency text (`'1200 AED'` → `1200`) and write a numeric `price_aed`. Any value that doesn't parse stays empty rather than turning into a 0, so bad rows are visible instead of silently skewing your model. 3. **Leave `cancelled` exactly as it is** — no recoding, no reordering, and no other column dropped. Output is one clean table, and the steps are saved as a recipe you rerun on Monday's new export with the same settings — which is what keeps each week's training data comparable. You'll get the cleaned table plus a short before/after count so you can see the drop and any prices that failed to parse.

(I left out the parts whose numbers I cannot source from you or your data. Ask me about any part in words and I will go through it.)
